# otp-migrate.sccl.cc

Client-side Google Authenticator OTP migration decoder.

## What it does
Decodes the `otpauth-migration://` QR codes exported by Google Authenticator.
Extracts individual TOTP/HOTP secrets for import into other authenticator apps.

## How it works
1. Scan or upload the migration QR code from Google Authenticator
2. The app decodes the protobuf data entirely in your browser
3. Get individual `otpauth://` URIs and QR codes for each account
4. Import into Bitwarden, Authy, or any TOTP-compatible app

## Privacy
All processing happens client-side. No data is sent to any server.
